claim.title: Native reviewed removal of one obsolete denominated monthly budget
claim.body:
External source contribution claim: `chatgpt:5f566b5ec8ef:production`.

The current executable parent PR #8 (`591ab6f5a2d65bf596aeb707dbb635ee981ec926`, tree `bf7d8bedaa3ed02665e56b021f543259b8c4a854`, 116 leaves) can set/list budgets but cannot remove an obsolete allowance; setting zero retains a budget row. Canonical main `c063549f5caae75a6bef764a5da703f0dccfec9f` remains README-only. Source receiving/disposition ownership of PR #8 remains with estate-ce7eb129730f / estate-61749b0088e2.

I am implementing a narrowly additive native TypeScript MCP preview/commit pair and terminal consumer: select one exact stored category, month and explicit currency; review the complete existing budget; explicitly confirm its content digest; fresh-check and remove only that array occurrence through the unchanged Store. Transactions, other budgets, unknown fields and current unrelated edits remain intact. Stale/missing/unassigned/ambiguous targets refuse without writes. This is current-value protection, not cross-process locking, authorization, or remove/recreate history detection. The terminal sends no mutation on cancel/EOF and never retries a commit automatically.

Scope: new removal module/client/CLI/tests/guide, additive tool definitions/dispatch in index and additive existing tool-roster expectations if needed. No ledger schema/Store, package/bin/lock/workflow, existing client, recording/import/copy/reallocation/report changes. Native qualification uses only private authored ledgers on MSI. Native root: `D:/HAMON/household-budget-removal-5f566b5ec8ef`; `CONTRACT.json` was written before implementation.

Ownership evidence: current open scopes, all 31 core issue #3 comments, targeted removal search, and 761 readable existing native coordination records were checked; no budget-removal owner found. The Conscience database currently fails with disk I/O under the confirmed storage outage; no append or lease is asserted. This is the established external source-claim fallback only.

No-Actions hold remains active. The current canonical tree has no workflows. The executable parent's sole complete workflow `ci.yml` (`39325b079fb40b0587ec231eeb3328f52e7ece74`) triggers only push/main and pull_request/main; this metadata issue is not eligible. No source push, PR, merge, workflow/runner change, live ledger action or installed service change is included.
